LanguageData.RMush_PsychedelicExperience.stages.0.des: Colors and patterns ripple like sunlight on water. Has the world always been this dazzling?
LanguageData.RMush_PsychedelicExperience.stages.1.des: A thin mist seems to hang between me and the world. My eyes are open, yet I'm floating through a dream.
LanguageData.RMush_PsychedelicExperience.stages.2.des: Unfamiliar shadows seem to cover a place I know. I can't tell what's real, and I keep feeling afraid.
